headlines.title: NBC Los Angeles helicopter crashes while covering fatal bus accident
headlines.description: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass offered prayers to the families and loved ones of the victims as three people were killed when a helicopter from NBC Los Angeles crashed while covering a bus accident. An L.A. Metro bus and a passenger vehicle were involved in that accident that killed two people and injured others.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve to announce interest rate decision as Trump calls for a cut
headlines.description: Wall Street expects the Fed to hike rates Wednesday. The president wants a rate cut.

headlines.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s efforts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections in November. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down what’s at stake with the decision.

headlines.title: Multiple artists quit Ed Sheeran tour
headlines.description: Major acts touring with Ed Sheeran have quit after rapper Macklemore was forced out due to his support of Palestinians. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda has the story.

headlines.title: Kennedy Center to close for two years as Trump says renovation hinges on his name
headlines.description: The Kennedy Center board voted to immediately close the main building for a two-year renovation, hours after a federal judge blocked efforts to put President Trump’s name on the building. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: FBI files reveal new details about attempted Trump assassin
headlines.description: The FBI has released new documents about the assassination attempt on President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania. One rally goer told the FBI the attempted assassin Thomas Crooks was making "hateful comments" about Trump before the attack. NBC News' Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: Apple’s record night and Colbert’s Emmys wins highlight TV in transition
headlines.description: Apple took home a total of 28 trophies, with a record 14 for freshman comedy “Widow’s Bay.”

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: 3 dead after news helicopter crashes while covering fatal L.A. bus collision
headlines.description: A KNBC helicopter was covering a Los Angeles Metro bus and a passenger vehicle collision, which killed two people and injured others, fire officials said.

headlines.title: Would-be Trump assassin practiced shooting a day before attempt in Pennsylvania, documents show
headlines.description: Thomas Matthew Crooks struck Trump in the ear during a 2024 rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. He was subsequently shot dead by the Secret Service.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve to announce interest rate decision as Trump calls for a cut
headlines.description: Wall Street expects the Fed to hike rates Wednesday. The president wants a rate cut.

headlines.title: Kash Patel defends FBI’s new policy on bestiality at Senate hearing
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy grilled the FBI director about a recently revised policy that doesn’t automatically disqualify job applicants who have engaged in bestiality.
